name: Apex Clean Energy
description: Charlottesville, Virginia-based developer, owner and operator of utility-scale wind, solar and storage projects.
business_model: Develops renewable projects and increasingly owns/operates them as an IPP, recycling capital via asset stake sales.
notes: Sept 2026 report: Apex has 2.2 GW operating/under construction.

holding.status_note: Ares still described as majority owner in Sept 2026

name: Club Atlético de Madrid
description: Madrid LaLiga football club playing at the Riyadh Air Metropolitano, also owning Atlético de San Luis and Atlético Ottawa.
business_model: Broadcasting, matchday, commercial and stadium/real-estate revenue, with a planned Ciudad del Deporte district.

holding.status_note: Ares funds remain shareholders after Apollo Sports Capital became majority owner (completed Mar 2026)

name: Commonwealth LNG
description: 9.5 mtpa LNG export facility under development in Cameron, Louisiana, sponsored by Kimmeridge/Caturus; FID taken May 2026.
business_model: Liquefaction and export of U.S. natural gas under long-term offtake contracts.
notes: Caturus release describes Ares as financing partner; 10-Q classifies holding as preferred equity. Exact Ares entry date not disclosed.

holding.status_note: Preferred equity at Commonwealth LNG Intermediate Parent, LLC held at 30 Jun 2026

name: Convergint Technologies
description: Global provider of technology-enabled security and safety solutions, covering design, installation, integration, management and service.
subsector: Security & safety systems integration and services
business_model: Service-led systems integrator operating 220+ technology centres across the Americas, APAC and EMEA; growth through organic service expansion and acquisitions (40+ since 2018).
notes: Matt Cwiertnia (Head of Ares Private Equity) chairs Convergint's Board of Managers.

holding.status_note: Ares closed an ~$850M single-asset continuation vehicle (led by LGP) in Mar 2026 and made a new investment alongside it; retains shared control with LGP and Harvest Partners.
holding.value_creation_plan: Continue growth record (Adjusted EBITDA roughly quadrupled since 2018) via organic growth and M&A.

name: Cooper's Hawk Winery & Restaurants
description: Restaurant and winery lifestyle brand combining full-service restaurants, tasting rooms and a large wine club.
business_model: Restaurant sales plus a recurring wine-club membership model; produces its own wines.
notes: HQ Countryside, Illinois (2019). ~70 units as of Jan 2025.

holding.status_note: Ares investment July 2019; described as Ares-backed in 2022; no exit found through Sept 2026 (latest owner confirmation is 2022).

name: EDPR U.S. diversified renewables portfolio
description: Portfolio of 10 operating U.S. renewable assets (1,632 MW: 1,030 MW solar, 402 MW wind, 200 MW storage) across four power markets, contracted under long-term PPAs.
subsector: Solar, wind and battery storage generation
business_model: Contracted power sales under long-term PPAs (average ~18 years remaining); EDPR retains 51% and operates.
notes: Ares said the deal took its Infrastructure Opportunities renewables capacity to ~5.7 GW across 11 states since Sept 2024. Separate closing release not found.

holding.status_note: Ares Infrastructure Opportunities stake announced as acquired Oct 2025;

name: ENGIE North America renewables and storage portfolio
description: Minority stakes in ENGIE-operated U.S. operating renewables and storage portfolios in ERCOT, MISO, PJM and SPP, totalling about 4.3 GW across three tranches.
subsector: Solar, wind and battery storage generation
business_model: Contracted and merchant power sales from operating solar, wind and co-located storage; ENGIE retains control and operates the assets.

holding.status_note: Partnership expanded in Mar 2025 and Jan 2026; total relationship 4.3 GW

name: EP Wealth Advisors
description: Fee-only registered investment adviser headquartered in Torrance, California, managing over $40 billion for clients.
business_model: Fee-based wealth management and financial planning across 50+ offices; inorganic growth via RIA acquisitions.
notes: AUM ~$40B as of 2025-08-31; >$42.2B per Mar 2026 report. Patrick Goshtigian is Executive Chair.

holding.status_note: Significant minority investment announced 2025-09-30; Houlihan Lokey lists it as closed; Mar 2026 reporting cites Ares as an investor.
holding.value_creation_plan: Capital to invest in talent, technology and client service, and to pursue M&A partnerships.

name: Epika Fleet Services
description: Mobile-focused provider of preventative maintenance and repair services for commercial trucking fleets, headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee.
subsector: Mobile preventative maintenance and repair for commercial truck fleets
business_model: Sends mobile technicians to customer fleet locations (plus ~20 in-shop service centres) across nearly 40 states, serving 2,000+ fleet customers with 550+ technicians.
notes: Advisers: William Blair, Reed Smith, Maslon (Epika); Piper Sandler, Sullivan & Cromwell (Ares).

holding.status_note: Majority stake acquired by an Ares Private Equity fund; acquisition announced as completed 2025-04-21;
holding.value_creation_plan: Ares cited growing fleet-operator demand for mobile service that reduces operating complexity and improves fleet productivity.

name: Form Technologies
description: Charlotte, North Carolina-based maker of precision-engineered components for automotive, aerospace, healthcare and enterprise technology markets.
subsector: Precision-engineered components (die casting, metal injection moulding, investment casting)
business_model: Contract manufacturer producing over 5 billion components a year from 32 facilities in 22 countries.
notes: Release describes Ares funds generically; Employee count stated as 'over 7,500'.

holding.status_note: Ares-managed funds acquired majority of common equity in Jan 2025 deleveraging transaction.
holding.value_creation_plan: Deleverage balance sheet, invest in operations and regional presence, accelerate commercial strategy.

name: France SailGP Team
description: French team competing in the SailGP international sailing championship.
business_model: Team revenues from sponsorship, league distributions and commercial rights within SailGP.

holding.status_note: Stake acquisition announced 18 Jun 2025

name: Inter Miami CF
description: Miami-based Major League Soccer club owned by Jorge Mas, Jose Mas and David Beckham.
business_model: Matchday, sponsorship, media and merchandise revenue.

holding.status_note: Listed by Ares as a portfolio holding in Jun 2025;

name: Landscape Workshop
description: Grounds maintenance provider in the Southeastern US, founded 1984, with 38 locations.
business_model: Recurring commercial landscape maintenance contracts plus installation and irrigation services; buy-and-build.
notes: HQ Birmingham, Alabama. Advisors: Piper Sandler; K&L Gates (company); Kirkland & Ellis (Ares).

holding.status_note: Majority stake acquired May 2025.
holding.value_creation_plan: Accelerate growth through strategic acquisitions and customer expansion.

name: Meade Pipeline Co LLC
description: Owns about 40% of the Central Penn Line, a FERC-regulated 180-mile natural gas pipeline in northeast Pennsylvania (~2.3 Bcf/d gross) operated by Williams.
subsector: Natural gas pipeline (Central Penn Line interest)
business_model: Earns lease/transport income from long-term triple-net lease arrangements with Williams, the operator and joint owner.
notes: Related entity Redwood Meade Midstream MPC LLC also held by Ares Core Infrastructure Fund.

holding.status_note: Acquisition completed Sept 2025

name: Miami Dolphins (incl. Hard Rock Stadium and F1 Miami Grand Prix)
description: NFL franchise together with Hard Rock Stadium and the Formula 1 Crypto.com Miami Grand Prix within Stephen Ross's sports and entertainment portfolio.
business_model: Media rights, ticketing, sponsorship, hospitality and events revenue.

holding.status_note: 10% limited interest; NFL-approved Dec 2024

name: Plenitude (Eni Plenitude S.p.A. Società Benefit)
description: Eni-controlled integrated energy-transition company combining renewable generation (~4.8 GW), retail gas/power supply to ~10m customers and EV charging.
subsector: Renewables, energy retail and EV charging
business_model: Integrated model: renewable generation, retail energy sales and e-mobility charging services.
notes: Held by Ares Alternative Credit funds (not Infrastructure); may overlap with credit/other slice.

holding.status_note: 20% held at 30 Sep 2026; follow-on to 26.24% with joint control completed 1 Oct 2026
holding.value_creation_plan: Company targets 10 GW of installed renewable capacity by 2028 (per Ares release).

name: Resource Label Group
description: Franklin, Tennessee-based provider of pressure-sensitive labels, shrink sleeves, folding cartons, flexible packaging and RFID/NFC solutions.
business_model: Label and packaging manufacturer serving food, beverage, pharma, personal care and medical device customers; acquisition-led consolidator.
notes: Mike Apperson was President and CEO per 2021 release; current CEO not re-verified.

holding.status_note: Described as 'a portfolio company of Ares Management' in Feb 2025 add-on announcement.

name: Rover Pipeline
description: Roughly 700-mile natural gas transmission pipeline across Pennsylvania, West Virginia, Ohio and Michigan with 3.425 Bcf/d of capacity, operated by Energy Transfer.
business_model: Fee-based transportation revenue, mostly under long-term capacity contracts.
notes: Held in Ares Core Infrastructure Fund as ET Rover Pipeline LLC (fair value $1.61bn at 30 Jun 2026).

holding.status_note: 32.4% stake acquired from Blackstone, completed Apr 2026

name: Sagepoint Energy
description: Carmel, Indiana-based RNG platform owning dairy anaerobic digesters, a Wisconsin biorefinery, landfill-gas-to-RNG plants and organics logistics.
business_model: Converts agricultural and landfill waste into renewable natural gas and provides waste-management and logistics services to farms.

holding.status_note: Formed 2025 from Ares-backed Dynamic Renewables, BC Organics and National Organics

name: Savers Value Village
description: Largest for-profit thrift operator in the US and Canada, selling value-priced pre-owned clothing, accessories and household goods.
business_model: Sources donated goods via nonprofit partners and processes and sells them through its own thrift stores.
notes: HQ Bellevue, Washington. Holdings after Aug 2026 sale: ACOF V 53,083,382; ASOF Holdings I 26,223,742; ASSF IV AIV B Holdings III 5,435,262; ASSF IV AIV B 7,945,865 shares.

holding.status_note: NYSE: SVV. Ares PE and Opportunistic Credit funds sold 23M shares in Aug 2026; Ares entities held ~94.4M shares afterward.

name: The Aspen Group (Aspen Dental / WellNow)
description: Healthcare services group that supports Aspen Dental-branded practices and operates WellNow urgent care clinics.
subsector: Dental support organisation and urgent care
business_model: Provides non-clinical business support services to affiliated dental practices; owns/operates 150+ WellNow urgent care clinics.
notes: Approx. $3B term loans due Dec 2027; WellNow sale paused mid-2026.

holding.status_note: June 2026 credit reporting names Ares, Leonard Green and American Securities as sponsors; company pursuing refinancing and preferred equity raise.

name: The Lockwood Group
description: Stamford, Connecticut-based healthcare communications firm providing medical communications, consulting, education and market access services to life sciences companies.
business_model: Fee-based services to pharma, biotech and medtech clients; growth through acquisitions (e.g., Total Health Oncology, 2026).
notes: Christine Hinkle was COO per 2021 release (not re-verified).

holding.status_note: Ares strategic investment Oct 2021; no exit found through Sept 2026 (company releases from 2026 don't name its owners).
holding.value_creation_plan: Invest in people, customers and capabilities; organic and inorganic growth.

name: Whitestone REIT
description: Houston-based owner-operator of about 54-56 convenience-focused retail centres (~4.8m sq ft) in Phoenix, Austin, Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston and San Antonio.
business_model: Leases small-format, community-centred retail space to service, restaurant and local tenants.

holding.status_note: Take-private completed 13 Jul 2026; delisted
